title: What's a Crab Doing in the Cooking Pot?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager lifts the lid of the cooking pot and finds a crab inside, looking as if the villager is the intruder.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) lifts the lid off the cooking pot to start the stew and finds a crab sitting inside it. Not a crab that anyone caught. A crab that has climbed in all by itself, and is now sitting at the bottom of the empty pot, claws raised, looking up at (subject) as if (subject.he/she) is the intruder.

choices.label: Carry It Back to the Beach
Ask the Crab What It Wants

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) carries the whole pot down to the beach and tips it gently onto the sand. The crab marches out sideways without so much as a thank you. (subject) carries the pot back up. As (subject.he/she) lifts the lid to start cooking, (subject.he/she) half expects to find another one. There isn't. (subject.He/She) checks twice anyway.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "What are you doing in there?" (subject) asks. The crab waves a claw. (friend), passing, says, "Maybe it heard you make good stew." (subject) decides to take that as a compliment, carries the crab out to the rocks, and makes the stew without it. The stew is, everyone agrees, very good. The crab would have been impressed.
